description: Election Commission - Mrs. T. P. S. Priyanga's, Mr. E. J. P. Jayalath's and Mr. S. K. A. Kusumsiri's have been removed from the Nomination list of Weligama Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding the forfeiture of rights of specific candidates in the Weligama Urban Council due to their cessation of membership in the United National Party. The content directly relates to electoral processes, candidate nominations, and party membership matters, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
